messages:
Samir K.: hey all, i started today! quick q — who should i ping for: VPC access, dedicated GPU pool creds, and repo permissions? getting through my first-day checklist and want to line up owners :wave:
Maya (DevEx): welcome Samir!! :tada: for onboarding flows ping @Maya (DevEx) (you're already in luck :slightly_smiling_face:). but for specific things: Jordan handles VPC/network, Simon handles dedicated infra/oncall for GPU infra, and Alex in people-ops for org permissions. also check the onboarding doc: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboarding/week1
Jordan - Infra: hey Samir — quick checklist to open an infra access ticket (please paste this into the ticket):
```
resource: VPC / subnet / bastion
project: <project-name>
reason: <brief justification>
ssh_pubkey: <ssh-rsa AAAA...>
env: dev/staging/prod
required_by: <date>
```
include the project and whether you need egress rules. once the ticket is in, we'll triage and loop in the network team. cc: @Maya (DevEx) if you need help with the template.
Samir K.: awesome thanks — for the dedicated GPU pool who do i page if jobs are getting queued or latency is high? we have a model training that needs predictable throughput next week :grimacing:
Simon SRE: that's oncall -> eng-oncall handles incidents for Dedicated. page @eng-oncall or open an incident in our PagerDuty rotation (service: dedicated-gpu-serving). for capacity/throughput adjustments, tag @eng-platform and include workload profile (qps, seq length, batch size). also add a perf sample if you have one. :ok_hand:
Maya (DevEx): also FYI we have a 1-pager on common owner contacts in the onboarding doc (under "who to ping"). it lists escalation lanes: first ping owner, if no response in 2h escalate to team lead, then to eng-sre oncall for incidents.
Samir K.: perfect. last one — who owns model access and private deployment creds? trying to know who signs off for private model pulls.
Aria (Eng-ML): for model permissions and private deploys ping eng-ml (aria is the steward for model-onboarding). if it's a private deployment tied to a customer VPC then Jordan + security review required. we also need an entry in the model registry with tags: team, privacy-level, and allowed-envs.
welcome-bot: Welcome Samir K.! You've been added to #new-hires, the onboarding checklist, and given read access to the company wiki. :confetti_ball:
Samir K.: thanks everyone — i'll open the infra ticket now and paste that template. looping in @Maya (DevEx) for follow-ups. :raised_hands:
